symptom: every Data grid Drop-down filter mxcli created failed mx check 11.14.0 with CE0463 (9 on the 68-page testapp copy); mxcli docker check labelled them stale and update-widgets cleared them
cause: two gaps on emptyOptionCaption: the editorConfig hides it with `(e.filterable||e.multiSelect)&&hidePropertyIn(…)`, a disjunctive guard the extractor did not lift, so the hidden template was never nulled; and while visible Studio Pro stores the shipped default text (None/Niets) where the embedded template held an empty template and the visible fill wrote an empty one, because top-level property entries did not carry DefaultTranslations
fix: lift a statement-level `(A||B…)&&hide(P)` as one rule per disjunct (exact: any firing rule hides); fill a visible unset conditional text template with the declared translations; give the template's emptyOptionCaption the shipped text
insight: the first path diff (Studio vs mxcli) showed only Object.Properties ORDER differences — a red herring, update-widgets does not reorder them. Diffing mxcli's widget against the same widget after `mx update-widgets` gave the one real change. Nulling the template alone moved the failures to the other filters, which is what showed the value depends on configuration; then the editorConfig named the rule. An empty template is not wrong everywhere: the text/number filters' screenReaderInputCaption ships text and mx check accepts an empty one
